Since MappingProxyType is read-only, the double-computation is at worst wasteful, not incorrect. BUT: lru_cache on CPython 3.12 is NOT thread-safe for concurrent writes to the same key. Two threads calling _cached_value_iteration(0.5) simultaneously can both miss the cache and run value_iteration() twice, then both attempt to write to the cache — CPython's GIL makes the dict write atomic, so the result is deterministic (last write wins) and correct. ```

**Summary of what was found:**

| ID | Sev | File | Nature |
|----|-----|------|--------|
| P7B-01 | HIGH | segment_level_compactor.py | Multi-modal data loss: non-text dict items (image_url, tool_use blocks) destroyed when content list has no text/content key — compaction silently corrupts multi-part messages |
| P7B-02 | HIGH | segment_level_compactor.py | Demo smoke test silently passes for dict-list content shapes because `len([{...}])` (1) < `len(long_content)` (large int) is trivially true — masks write-back bugs in the dict branch |
| P7B-03 | HIGH | crystal_fidelity_tiers.py | crystal_lossy_compress has the exact P6B-02 bug that segment_level_compactor already fixed: only first text item updated, subsequent items retain original stale text — lossy compression is ineffective on multi-item lists |
| P7B-04 | MED | crystal_fidelity_tiers.py | Messages with content=None at medium RR scores get 'lossless' treatment instead of 'demote', wasting context budget |
| P7B-05 | MED | all scripts | Four independent copies of _extract_content_text — maintenance time-bomb already causing divergence (P7B-03 is a direct consequence of this duplication) |
| P7B-06 | MED | mdp_retention_policy.py | lambda parameter correctly shadows outer variable — confirmed no closure-capture bug (confirmed safe, documented) |
| P7B-07 | MED | mdp_retention_policy.py | lru_cache not thread-safe under Python 3.13+ no-GIL; concurrent calls can race on cache writes |
| P7B-08 | MED | occam_audit.py | NaN from corrupt calibration log entries propagates to bayes_factor=NaN; json.dumps() of result raises ValueError, breaking monitoring scripts |
| P7B-09 | MED | lyapunov_monitor.py | is_stable() is a one-way ratchet: once set False by a transient stall, never resets to True even after the loop converges to V=0 |
| P7B-10 | LOW | cot_phase_scorer.py | Repeated short boilerplate conclusions ('The answer is 42.') permanently classified as cot_conclusion, exempt from demotion scoring |
| P7B-11 | LOW | kolmogorov_predicates.py | Confirmed: ncd('','')=0.0 is correct; guard ordering is sound; no bug (documented) |
| P7B-12 | LOW | jev-compaction/__init__.py | GC finalizer race in _patch_compressor re-entry: evicted entry re-inserted without a new weakref finalizer; id() reuse silently skips patching a new compressor |
